errors.text_span: Освен плътните линии, във всяка от трите серии са нанесени и отделни кръгли точки (без свързваща линия)
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies the dotted trend lines as 'separate round dots (without a connecting line)'. In the chart, these are clearly dotted lines, which is a standard line style, not a scatter plot of unconnected points.

errors.text_span: Показани са три цветови серии със плътни линии без видими маркери
errors.evidence: This initial statement is incomplete as it omits the fact that there are also three corresponding dotted lines (trend lines) in the same colors. A clearer description would introduce both line types together, for example, by stating that each category is represented by both a solid and a dotted line.
